about: Records written by a person, for knowledge the extracted records miss. Each one cites its source and says why it exists. Reviewed like code: changes go through a pull request. Remove a record once the documents it stands in for are revised.

records.text: E-519 (C-3): the speed sensor signal was lost while riding. Check the magnet on the rear wheel and the sensor cable.
records.note: Added by firmware 3.2. ERR-C3-R2 doesn't list it yet; remove once the next revision does.
